findings.issue_text: Cleanup logs every selected ID at error level for each batch, creating enormous high-severity log entries and excessive allocation, I/O, and storage pressure for large batches
Successful cleanup batches emit a second error-level log, flooding error monitoring and doubling per-batch logging overhead
Reducing the cleanup ticker from ten minutes to one minute runs cleanup jobs ten times more often, unnecessarily increasing steady-state database load and contention

goldens.comment: The code uses Error log level for what appears to be debugging information. This will pollute error logs in production. Consider using Debug or Info level instead.

The cleanup job ticker was changed from 10 minutes to 1 minute, which can lead to increased database load and contention due to more frequent execution of cleanup tasks. This change should be reviewed to ensure it aligns with performance expectations.

per_golden_matches.reasoning: Both comments identify the same issue: using Error log level inappropriately for non-error information.
